title: Preserve structured offer eligibility through deterministic publication
objective: Publish explicit structured eligibility and commercial/personal usage restrictions without inferring from prose, preserve them in immutable version facts and hashes, and expose the persisted restrictions through existing read and adviser paths.
acceptance_criteria: A1: publication accepts only absent/None/non-empty exact strings for eligibility and absent/None/exact bools for commercial_use_allowed and personal_use_allowed; invalid explicit runtime types fail schema_complete without coercion or protocol calls.
A2: official evidence-backed invalid input routes to REVIEW with publish_error absent and creates no Service, Offer, OfferVersion, or Quota graph; a valid peer in the same scan still publishes.
A3: eligibility, commercial_use_allowed, and personal_use_allowed are NON_QUOTA_FIELDS and never create Quota rows or affect numeric determinism.
A4: Offer mutable columns preserve exact explicit values including None, and republishing an existing offer updates changed values.

A5: immutable OfferVersion material_facts and content_hash include the three structured fields; identical republish is idempotent and a material eligibility change creates a new version while preserving the prior version.
A6: notes or arbitrary prose never fabricate structured eligibility or usage-right values.

A7: read API returns exact structured restrictions and adviser commercial-use constraints reject commercial_use_allowed=False while a personal-use-compatible request can select the same otherwise suitable offer.
A8: optional field absence does not alter completeness weights, personal-use-only facts do not change monetary Z0 semantics, and arbitrary eligibility text does not create a new classifier rule.
A9: no migration, model, provider profile/fixture, dependency, workflow, feature-ledger, classifier, or quota-parser change is introduced.
verification_plan: Reproduce the untouched-main loss using an official evidence-backed candidate against isolated PostgreSQL 16.

.venv/Scripts/pytest.exe -q tests/unit/test_publish_revalidate.py tests/integration/test_publish_pipeline.py tests/integration/test_read_api.py tests/integration/test_adviser_recommend.py with DATABASE_URL targeting isolated PostgreSQL 16.
.venv/Scripts/pytest.exe -q with DATABASE_URL targeting isolated PostgreSQL 16; expect 1518+ passing tests and exactly two stack-health skips.
git diff --exit-code origin/main across dependency manifests and all out-of-scope zero-diff paths.
Fresh Level-2 evaluator commissioned by the owner after the draft PR; builder does not mark F008 passing.
mutation_plan: M1: remove eligibility keys from stable material facts; idempotency/version/content-hash tests must fail.
M2: replace exact runtime-type checks with truthiness or coercion; adversarial impostor tests must fail.
M3: omit persisted commercial/personal fields from adviser selection; commercial rejection and personal-compatible selection tests must fail.
data_implications: No schema or migration change. Future Offer rows retain explicit mutable eligibility fields, and future immutable OfferVersion rows include them in material_facts and content_hash. Existing immutable versions are not rewritten.
security_privacy: No network, secret, authentication, authorization, or user-controlled URL change. Invalid structured runtime values fail before persistence.
portability: Pure Python validation and existing PostgreSQL columns only; no new dependency or platform-specific behavior.
z0_risk: High data-integrity risk but no monetary-classification semantic change. Structured usage restrictions must be visible and adviser-enforced while billing-safe personal-only offers remain eligible for the existing Z0 decision gates.
